title: multiprocessing: on Windows, a message over 4,294,967,247 bytes raises OSError and breaks a waiting receiver
author: dennev
body_preview: ### Bug report  On Windows, `PipeConnection._send_bytes()` in `multiprocessing.connection` writes each message with a single `WriteFile()`. Windows refuses a pipe write of more than 4,294,967,247 bytes (0xFFFFFFCF) with `ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER`, so `send()` and `send_bytes()` of a larger message raise `OSError: [WinError 87] The parameter is incorrect`.
